SELECT 
    a.artname,
    a.artdynasty,
    ROUND(CAST((ar.histsignrating + ar.researchvalrating + ar.cultscore) * (10 - CASE a.conservestatus::text WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) / 30.0 AS numeric), 2) AS cpi_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN (ar.histsignrating + ar.researchvalrating + ar.cultscore) * (10 - CASE a.conservestatus::text WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) / 30.0 > 7 THEN 'High Priority'
        WHEN (ar.histsignrating + ar.researchvalrating + ar.cultscore) * (10 - CASE a.conservestatus::text WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) / 30.0 > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority'
        ELSE 'Low Priority'
    END AS conservation_priority_level
FROM artifactscore a
JOIN artifactratings ar ON a.artregistry = ar.artref
WHERE a.artdynasty IN ('Ming', 'Qing', 'Tang')
ORDER BY cpi_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
